instructions: Speak in an original adult female voice. Quiet, restrained and distant; soft breath, precise pronunciation, low emotional intensity, subtle melancholy. Do not imitate any existing character or performer.

profiles.instructions: Speak quietly and deliberately in an original adult female voice. Restrained, distant, precise, subtly melancholic. Use gentle breath and slightly longer pauses. Do not imitate any existing character or performer.
Speak in the same original voice, calm under pressure. Short, clear, restrained tactical delivery with little breathiness and no shouting.
Speak in the same original restrained voice with slight breath instability and fatigue. Stay controlled; do not exaggerate pain.

_comment: 复制为 UserSettings/tts_config.json 并填入真实 API Key。Unity 编辑器始终优先读取该 gitignored 文件，方便调音；运行时同时迁移加密副本到 persistentDataPath。正式包只读取 persistentDataPath/tts_config.json。调整 voice、instructions、speed 或 profiles 会产生新的缓存键，无需手动清缓存。
